subject: Coupa vendor registration + MSA redlines — field mapping and next steps
messages:
From: Talon Health Procurement <procurement@talonhealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Rahman <amir.rahman@talonhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coupa onboarding — MSA redlines and PO field constraints

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this — Talon is trying to complete vendor setup in our Coupa instance and we hit two blockers that need legal/ops coordination before we can provision you as a vendor and configure PO routing. Attached is our vendor onboarding checklist and the specific Coupa field requirements we enforce.

Two immediate asks:
- Can Redwood accept the redline in Section 10 (data retention / deletion) as marked in the attached MSA? Our security team requires a 30-day purge for sandbox data and a 7-year retention carve-out for billing records.
- We need confirmation on the exact values you will publish for the following PO fields: Vendor Code, Remit To Email, Invoice Format (PDF/EDI), and whether you support bill-to/ship-to split on the PO. Our Coupa system enforces specific enums and we need these to create the vendor record.

If you can reply with a short summary and attach an MSA with your tracked changes, we can route the redlines through our legal and vendor-ops queues. If easier, we can do a quick sync — Amir and I are available Wednesday afternoon (1:00–3:30 PT).

Thanks,
Jill Martin
Director, Procurement Operations
Talon Health

Attachments: Talon_Coupa_Vendor_Requirements.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Talon Health Procurement <procurement@talonhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding — MSA redlines and PO field constraints

Jill —

Thanks for the clear checklist and call offer. Quick answers up front so your ops queue can proceed:
- We attached our current MSA with tracked changes (Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx). High level: we can accept most operational language but Karthik (cc'd) will flag a couple of clauses (indemnity cap and deletion sequencing) that may require short negotiation.
- PO fields: we support Vendor Code (alphanumeric), Remit To Email (invoices@redwood.com), Invoice Format: PDF primary, EDI via SFTP as an option, and we can accept bill-to/ship-to splits. I've also attached a sample mapping for Coupa export (Coupa_PO_field_mapping_sample.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to provide a legal summary of the redlines and identify true "non-starters".
2) If Talon is amenable, we prepare a one-page schedule (Order Form) that maps the PO fields and invoicing flow; then send to DocuSign for signature.
3) Operational onboarding: exchange test POs and remit details once vendor record is created.

Lauren — can you own scheduling with Talon for the Wednesday window if that works?

Happy to hop on a call if that speeds this up.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx, Coupa_PO_field_mapping_sample.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Talon Health Procurement <procurement@talonhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding — MSA redlines and PO field constraints

Hi all —

I reviewed the attached MSA redline (thanks Ben). Summary for Talon legal:
- Items we can accept with minor edits: service level definitions (Section 4), support escalation, confidentiality carve-outs.
- Items requiring further negotiation: indemnity language (Section 8) — we propose a mutual cap tied to fees for the initial 12 months; data deletion clause (Section 10) — we need to preserve limited logs for fraud & billing reconciliation for up to 2 years unless Talon requires a stricter timeline supported by a specific business/legal justification.
- Export/control: we will provide a limited, auditable process to respond to eDiscovery requests but cannot commit to irrevocable deletion across backups without reasonable notice.

Operational asks for vendor-ops: please confirm whether Coupa enforces an "Invoice Contact Email" at the vendor header level and whether the system supports multiple remit-to addresses per vendor location. If Coupa does not support multiple remit addresses, we will need a consolidated remit inbox and SFTP drop for bulk EDI.

If Talon agrees to the proposed indemnity cap language and a 24-month log retention carve-out for billing/fraud, we can prepare a redline-to-sign copy and the order-form skeleton. Happy to jump on the proposed Wednesday cadence or to propose a Thursday morning window if that helps legal alignment.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Talon Vendor Ops <vendor-ops@talonhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Rahman <amir.rahman@talonhealth.com>, Jill Martin <procurement@talonhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding — MSA redlines and PO field constraints

Ben/Karthik —

Thanks for the rapid responses. Quick operational clarifications:
- Coupa enforces a single "Invoice Contact Email" at the vendor header but supports multiple remit contacts via sites (one remit per site). You can surface multiple remit-to addresses by creating separate sites for each remit destination.
- PO number format: TAL-YYYY-###### (example: TAL-2027-004321). Please ensure your AP systems can parse that pattern for automated matching.
- Invoice format: we prefer PDF for first-pass; EDI via Coupa punchout is supported but requires a separate EDI integration workstream.

I've uploaded a short vendor onboarding guide to our shared drive (link below) and attached a minimal sample PO export for your mapping team.

Link: https://talonhealth.coupa/shared/vendor_onboarding_guide.pdf

If you can confirm that Redwood will: (1) accept TAL- prefixed PO numbers; (2) provide a remit email and indicate if you will use sites for multiple remits; and (3) agree to a trial period where we test EDI for high-volume invoices after go-live — we can move vendor creation to "pending legal acceptance" in Coupa today.

Best,
Vendor Ops — Talon Health

Attachments: Coupa_PO_field_mapping_sample.xlsx

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Talon Vendor Ops <talon.vendor-ops@talonhealth.com>, procurement@talonhealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding — MSA redlines and PO field constraints

All —

Great — appreciate the quick operational clarity. Confirmations below so your team can move the vendor record to "pending legal acceptance":
1) TAL- prefixed PO numbers: accepted. Our AP will add a parsing rule for TAL-YYYY-######.
2) Remit handling: we will use a single vendor header remit email (invoices@redwood.com) for initial provisioning and create separate sites for any additional remit destinations if required.
3) EDI: Redwood will evaluate EDI after go-live and is open to a phased EDI integration (trial after 60 days).

Karthik — for legal next steps, can you: (a) produce a short redline-to-sign (we'll aim to keep it to a one-page set of changes) that adopts the mutual indemnity cap we discussed; and (b) carve out a 24-month retention exception for billing/fraud reconciliation. If Talon legal accepts those two points, we can finalize an Order Form that maps the shop-flow and send to DocuSign.

I've attached a mutual action plan (Mutual_Action_Plan_Talon_vs_Redwood.xlsx) that shows owners and dates — proposed go-live target: 2027-06-15. Lauren will own the onboarding project on our side.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Karthik: redline-to-sign (due 2027-05-13)
- Talon legal: confirm acceptance of indemnity cap & 24-month carve-out (due 2027-05-14)
- Vendor Ops: provision vendor as "pending legal acceptance" in Coupa (today)
- Ben: schedule a 30-minute intake call (Lauren will pick the slot)

Thanks all — moving swiftly on this is great for both sides.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Talon_vs_Redwood.xlsx
